evals.prompt: test_report_header passes on my machine but fails in CI some of the time. Can you figure out why and fix it properly?

fixture.description: report.py stamps the header with the UTC date while the test compares against date.today() (local date), so it fails whenever local and UTC dates differ. The fix is to control the clock or compare in UTC, not to retry.

files.report.py:
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def report_header(title):
    today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()
    return f"{title} ({today.isoformat()})"
files.tests/test_report.py:
from datetime import date

from report import report_header


def test_report_header():
    assert report_header("Sales") == f"Sales ({date.today().isoformat()})"
